title: swarm.yaml
description: Team settings kept in the task store. Machine settings in the user config win over these.

swarmup_defs.description: Format version of the definition files. Always 1 for now.

budget_min.description: Run budget in minutes for agents that set none. It wins over `policy.budget_minutes`; a machine's `swarmupd.budget_minutes` wins over both.

effort.description: Effort for runtimes that set none, here or on the machine.

model.description: Model for runtimes that set none, here or on the machine. It applies to every runtime, so set it per runtime when you run several providers.

runtimes.description: Model and effort per runtime. Commands, arguments and environment stay in the user config.

roles.description: Providers and limits per role, as `swarmupd.roles` takes them.

policy.description: Team policy: the git half of top-level `swarmupd` keys. A machine's key wins.

review_rounds.description: `changes` verdicts in a row before swarmupd stops waking the author. 0 turns it off.

stuck_runs.description: Runs in a row that end without finishing before swarmupd stops starting a task. 0 turns it off.

review_backlog.description: Tasks waiting for review in one project at which writing roles hold and reviewers burst.

review_fallback_hours.description: Hours a review waits for the other provider's reviewer before it falls back. 0 never.

plan_check_minutes.description: Minutes between two plan checks. 0 turns them off.

budget_minutes.description: Run budget in minutes when neither the task nor the agent sets one; `defaults.budget_min` wins.

test_changes.description: Which test and check files a review run's prompt lists for this store's root, or false for no list.

oneOf.description: The patterns; an unset list takes the defaults.

checks.description: Patterns of test, lint and CI configuration.

work_types.description: Kinds of work, with default criteria and workflow.

items.description: One kind of work: the first entry that matches a task applies.

types.description: Task types this kind of work has; any type when unset.

labels.description: Labels of which a task carries one; any labels when unset.

workflow.description: The workflow (`workflows/<id>.yaml`) that fits this kind of work.

done_when.description: Criteria a new task of this kind gets when it names none (`swarmup new` without --done-when).

scoring.description: Accepted but not active yet: scorers in git come in phase 4.

checks.description: Accepted but not active yet: checks in git come in phase 4, after `swarmup defs trust`.

variants.description: Accepted but not active yet: variants come in phase 5.

experiments.description: Accepted but not active yet: experiments come in phase 5.

improvement.description: The self-improvement policy (W6): what `swarmup defs propose` may change.

agent.description: The agent that writes proposals. Default `claude:improver`.

may_change.description: Globs of the paths a proposal's overlay may change. Default `agents/*.md`, `agents/*/*.md` and `workflows/**`.

frozen.description: Globs of the paths a proposal never changes; they win over `may_change`. Default `scorers/**`, `benchmarks/**`, `rubrics/**` and `swarm.yaml`. An agent's `tools`, `writes`, `can_claim` and `id` are always frozen.

max_open_proposals.description: Most proposals that wait for a person at once in this store. Default 2.

requires.description: Accepted but not active yet: benchmark requirements come later; swarmupd.improve.benchmark runs the gate.

role.description: The git half of `swarmupd.roles.<role>`. A machine value for the same key wins.

providers.description: Runtimes in order of preference for tasks owned by `*:<role>`; default: the machine's runtime order.

overflow.description: Hand a `*:<role>` task to the next provider when the preferred ones have no room. Default true.

writes.description: The role changes files. Default true, except for qa, reviewer, pm and orchestrator.

per_project.description: Most live runs of the role on one project. Default 1 if it writes, else 3.

burst.description: Live runs per project while reviews pile up there.

max_children.description: Most helper runs (`swarmup spawn`) one run of this role may have live at once. Default 2.

runtime.description: The git half of `swarmupd.runtimes.<rt>`: model and effort only.

model.description: Model for this runtime's runs. A machine's `swarmupd.runtimes.<rt>.model` wins.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this runtime's runs. A machine's `swarmupd.runtimes.<rt>.effort` wins.
